candidateOutputs: J-point candidate equal to candidate QRS offset
rules: Candidate fiducials are engineering outputs only and remain unvalidated.
Missing P or T candidates remain absent; the implementation must not fabricate them.
Thresholds and search windows must be explicit and provenance-bound.
Candidate fiducials may feed measurement evaluation but do not create diagnosis.
Any source annotation used later for comparison remains source label, never project clinical gold.
evaluationUses: future QTDB/LUDB source-annotation agreement after separate data-rights review
